# F5-TTS 1.1.22 runtime for the PC: Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12, ROCm 7.2 (RX 6900 XT, gfx1030).
# Fine-tuning, Speak and the speech API's resident worker share it (docs/SPEECH_API.md §7).
# The stack spike S-2 measured on 2026-10-11 (D-046): torch 2.14.0+rocm7.2, torchaudio
# 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and triton-rocm from PyTorch's rocm7.2 index, torchcodec 0.16.0+cpu from its
# cpu index; every other package from PyPI, at the versions of its constraints
# (f5-tts-finetune-1.1.22-rocm7.2/constraints.txt): S-2's, but multidict 6.9.1 (6.8.0 before
# 2026-10-19, GHSA-54p9-h82j-f925) and aiohttp 3.14.4 (3.14.3 before 2026-10-19,
# GHSA-5wr8-gcqf-gqf3, GHSA-2g87-pp6c-29x5, GHSA-494j-54xm-rwp3).
# Every file is bound by SHA-256; three packages publish no wheel and build from their
# hash-bound sdists with the hash-locked build tools (requirements/development-build.txt),
# whose setuptools is the lock's own 84.0.0 (torch's).
#
# Install it with (a plan, unless both flags are given):
#   voice-lab finetune provision-runtime --target linux-rocm --runtime-root <dir> \
#     [--execute --allow-downloads]
# which runs, in the new venv:
#   python -B -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --require-virtualenv \
#     --isolated --no-cache-dir --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps \
#     -r requirements/development-build.txt
#   python -B -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --require-virtualenv \
#     --isolated --no-cache-dir --require-hashes --no-build-isolation --only-binary=:all: \
#     --no-binary=antlr4-python3-runtime,encodec,transformers-stream-generator \
#     -r requirements/runtimes/f5-tts-finetune-1.1.22-rocm7.2.txt
#
# The three index lines below are this header's, written by hand: the indexes belong in this
# file, because pip replaces its command line's index list with a requirements file's
# --index-url, and they must be in this order, PyPI first (an --extra-index-url before it would
# be dropped the same way). pip takes from PyTorch's indexes only files whose hashes are here.
# Everything after them is, unchanged, the output of (uv 0.12.21, repository root):
#   uv pip compile requirements/runtimes/f5-tts-finetune-1.1.22-rocm7.2/pyproject.toml \
#     -c requirements/runtimes/f5-tts-finetune-1.1.22-rocm7.2/constraints.txt \
#     --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 \
#     --only-binary :all: --no-binary antlr4-python3-runtime --no-binary encodec \
#     --no-binary transformers-stream-generator \
#     --generate-hashes --no-header
# (Neither --emit-index-url, which writes only PyPI, the two PyTorch indexes being explicit to
# uv, nor --emit-build-options: pip applies a file's format options in order, and uv writes
# `--only-binary :all:` last, which would cancel the three `--no-binary`.)
--index-url https://pypi.org/simple
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm7.2
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
